relationships.subject: HIF-1α
relationships.evidence_quote: As a downstream regulator of HIF‐1α, VEGF is a major regulator of endothelial cell proliferation, angiogenesis, and vascular permeability.

relationships.subject: Varicocele
relationships.evidence_quote: VEGF expression increased as a result of VC‐induced hypoxia, which led vascular endothelial cells to proliferate and migrate, and was critical for both healthy and pathological angiogenesis (Wang et al., 2021).

relationships.subject: Gui Zhi Fu Ling Wan
relationships.evidence_quote: The core active components and AKT/HIF1A had strong binding potential which may verify the important role of hypoxia‐related signalling pathway in treating VC, according to the results of molecular docking.

key_findings: Network pharmacology identified HIF1A, VEGFA, TP53, TNF, IL-6, AKT1 among core targets of GFW in varicocele; HIF-1 and PI3K-Akt pathways enriched.
Molecular docking showed quercetin, kaempferol, baicalein, beta-sitosterol and ellagic acid bind core targets with energies below -5.0 kcal/mol.
